resources.string: Lets a paired desktop you have approved tap, swipe and type on this screen. Turn this off at any time to stop all remote input immediately.

Asks you before a desktop is allowed to control this phone.
A desktop (%1$s) wants to control this phone.\n\nAccepting lets it see your screen, tap and type until you stop the agent.
A desktop wants to control this phone. Tap Accept to allow, or Decline to refuse.

Remote Control needs microphone access so you can record audio from your phone during a paired session. Audio is only captured when you explicitly start recording and is sent only to your paired desktop.
Remote Control needs storage access to send and receive files between your phone and desktop. Files are transferred only over your paired connection.
Remote Control uses location to show nearby devices on the same network for easier pairing. Location data never leaves your device.
Remote Control shows notifications when a paired desktop requests control or when mirroring is active. These alerts let you approve or reject sessions at any time.
Some permissions were denied. Related features will be limited until you grant them in Settings.
All permissions granted. You can now use every Remote Control feature.
